_comment: Single source of truth for which service owns which script. Patterns are regexes matched against the script path relative to fincept-qt/scripts. The first service (in order) with a matching pattern owns the script. Scripts nothing matches stay in the desktop app (local Python). Run gateway/gen_nginx.py after editing.

services.name: market-data
services.description: Quotes, history, search, company info (Yahoo Finance) with a warm worker pool

services.name: analytics
services.description: Quant, corporate finance, M&A, portfolio and technical analytics; notebook code cells

services.name: connectors
services.description: Economics, government, central-bank and other data connectors
